parameters.name: AllowCancel
parameters.description:
Specifies whether cancellation is allowed. Valid values:
- **-1**: allows cancellation of all O&M events.
- **0**: not allowed. 
- **1**: allowed.

parameters.name: AllowChange
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the time can be modified. Valid values:

- **-1**: allows modification of the time for all O&M events.
- **0**: not allowed. 
- **1**: allowed.

parameters.name: ChangeLevel
parameters.description:
The change level. Default value: all. Valid values:

- **all**: all levels of exception repair and system O&M.
- **S0**: exception repair.
- **S1**: system O&M.

parameters.name: DbType
parameters.description: The database type. Set the value to polarx.

parameters.name: InsName
parameters.description: The instance name. Default value: empty string.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description: The product name. Default value: polarx.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- **-1**: all pending and running tasks.  
- **3**: pending. 
- **4**: running.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The task type. A value of all indicates that all tasks of the user are queried. Set the value to all.
